evidence.guest-change: experiments/guest-admission/inputs.toml SHA-256 097f3195c2d0a4197ac7d0326b029770ef2d1ae6299c8606cf7dde54ccd70dd3 pins the added tools, framework and fixture inputs. experiments/guest-admission/results.toml SHA-256 79a921116620c964d84867adde03e67575887045c956dd7dd29c1b4ae2bba94d indexes source and raw evidence. The original image, stock APK copy, reference APK and reference native library remain unchanged. Each run uses fresh userdata and a per-run source snapshot. The report documents guest SELinux changes from Frida, in-memory admission scope, loopback transport, reproduction and discard-based rollback. No host policy or physical device was modified. The experiment applies no additional SELinux application-context mapping.
evidence.exception-controls: In probe-06 and probe-07, the original unhooked install rejected stock; the hook rejected unrelated package, different signer and changed-byte same-signer fixtures for their intended guards; only exact stock was admitted. The changed-byte fixture passes v2 verification with the stock signer. Pulled installed bytes retain SHA-256 6a08d97ff903e97c1c99792b69eef9b0a3bec0b43fe348e4af93861673bbec6b. Independent Kotlin verification checks actual packages.xml certificates: stock package signer preserved, system shared-UID platform signer preserved, and UID 1000 assigned. Reinstallation after hook detach again rejects stock under original signature policy.
evidence.repeated-probe: Fresh probe-06 (19:19:12Z to 19:21:11Z) and probe-07 (19:21:33Z to 19:23:27Z) on 2026-09-24 both pass tools/guest/VerifyAdmission.main.kts and all indexed raw checksums. Normal CLI deadline completion replaces signaled hook teardown. system_server PID remains 1067 throughout the first run and 1086 throughout the second, including after detach and post-launch observation; no server crash appears in the captured crash evidence. Frida preload and crash integration are disabled, its server is stopped before launch, and Zygote maps contain no Frida mapping. The failed probe-05 teardown is retained and explicitly excluded from the successful pair. Screenshots were visually reviewed: the first has a crash dialog, the second a black screen. Neither is app UI success. Private ADB, emulator and forwarding ports were verified closed after cleanup.
evidence.next-boundary: Both final runs record no SELinux context match for uid 1000, seinfo default, com.rigol.scope, followed by the Zygote child aborting with SIGABRT. Native tombstones and logs identify selinux_android_setcontext failure before application initialization. docs/research/guest-admission.md SHA-256 a31e830694685a658cf31dc2a098d8add696020f0cc5da03ab408f4a634c786a distinguishes this from instrument native execution and documents the preliminary harness failures and bounded stability claim. It recommends evaluating a scoped signer/package-to-seinfo assignment without implementing it or admitting successor tasks.
